categories.reading: Case-mix-adjusted commercial hospital prices averaged 253 percent of simulated Medicare prices, with wide state and provider variation.
categories.why_not_expected_value: Medicare is an administratively set reference and may not equal an adequate competitive payment for every hospital, service, or market.

categories.reading: Milliman estimated national commercial professional reimbursement at 139 percent of fully loaded Medicare FFS rates, with wide geographic variation; CBO separately supports the market-power mechanism.
categories.why_not_expected_value: The estimate trends earlier claims to 2023, includes professional services beyond physicians, and Medicare adequacy, input-cost, specialty-mix, quality, and access floors are not yet attached.

categories.reading: US retail pharmaceutical spending per person was the OECD's highest and more than twice its average.
categories.why_not_expected_value: Spending combines net prices, prescribing, therapeutic mix, quantities, margins, tax treatment, and retail-versus-hospital dispensing; it is not a drug-price index.

next_gate: For hospitals and professional services, refresh contemporaneous same-service claims and attach Medicare adequacy, input-cost, specialty/case-mix, quality, and access floors. For drugs, separate net price, therapeutic mix, quantity, and retail-versus-hospital scope before scoring.
